title: Bandwidth-Efficient and Privacy-Preserving Edge-Cloud Many-to-Many Speech Translation

bias_targets.methodology: The paper evaluates 'English-centric bias' by measuring translation performance (COMET and spBLEU scores) across 45 languages and 1,960 directions on the FLEURS dataset. It specifically analyzes 'cross-lingual consistency' by comparing performance across high, medium, and low-resource language tiers and comparing English-related directions against many-to-many (non-English) translation pairs.
